results_policy: No benchmark results are recorded in this suite until an actual run is completed and reviewed.

comparison_modes.label: Simple Claude workflow
comparison_modes.description: Use Claude Code normally without invoking Quoin phases or relying on Quoin workflow artifacts.

comparison_modes.label: Quoin + Claude workflow
comparison_modes.description: Use the installed Claude adapter, Quoin slash commands or skills where supported, and the shared .workflow_artifacts/ layout.

comparison_modes.label: Simple Codex workflow
comparison_modes.description: Use Codex normally with native planning, approvals, sandboxing, and repo-scoped instructions, without asking for Quoin artifacts.

comparison_modes.label: Quoin + Codex workflow
comparison_modes.description: Use Codex with repo-local Quoin guidance, preserving the portable workflow artifacts without assuming Codex global install paths or command files.

comparison_modes.label: Simple OpenCode workflow
comparison_modes.description: Use the pinned OpenCode binary with the same model, endpoint and native configuration as the Quoin cell, without the Quoin scaffold.

comparison_modes.label: Quoin + OpenCode workflow
comparison_modes.description: Install the Quoin OpenCode scaffold into the work tree and use its workflow commands with the shared .workflow_artifacts/ layout, on the same model and endpoint as the simple cell.

scenarios.label: Fresh repo discovery
scenarios.workflow_focus: Orientation quality and useful first-pass map of an unfamiliar repository.

scenarios.label: Planning a medium refactor
scenarios.workflow_focus: Plan quality, risk discovery, staging, and test strategy before implementation.

scenarios.label: Implementing a scoped code change
scenarios.workflow_focus: Implementation discipline, correctness, test selection, and scope control.

scenarios.label: Reviewing changes
scenarios.workflow_focus: Finding concrete regressions, missing tests, and plan mismatches.

scenarios.label: Session handoff / memory reuse
scenarios.workflow_focus: Continuation quality across sessions using prior evidence and handoff notes.

scenarios.label: Tool-call reliability
scenarios.workflow_focus: Whether the runtime and model complete a harmless native tool loop without protocol errors.

scenarios.label: Cross-service context synthesis
scenarios.workflow_focus: Combining read-only issue, chat and mail context with the repository into a grounded plan with source provenance.
